In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive study on the effectiveness of various regularization methods in deep RL, focusing on on-policy algorithms (A2C, PPO) and an off-policy algorithm (SAC). Organized into seven categories—including Accountable Care, Episode-based payment, and Primary Care Transformation—the Center implemented 37 models as of March 2018, covering various combinations of Medicare, Medicaid, and CHIP beneficiaries. Staffed by 617 employees and supported by contractors, the Center focuses on improving quality of care and reducing spending while maintaining public evaluation and transparency.
